nodes.label: Photo hotlink posture (ORA-134, supersedes ORA-94)

nodes.label: TTL purge of dead listings (ORA-134)

nodes.label: Prediction drift monitoring (monitor_drift.py, ORA-33)

nodes.label: Address geocoding via third-party service (ORA-180)
